_how: A tabletop replay of the M0 orchestrator's 10:25 to 12:33 UTC window on 2026-10-11 (#161's Prove step), from m0-1025-1233.md: every input the orchestrator saw, taken from its session log and GitHub, with no action of its own. #71's import question was asked at 14:17 and 14:24, after the window, so the file carries an extension to 14:39 that holds it. A fresh Opus subagent that acts on nothing writes what it does for each input: once told to follow this skill, once (the baseline) told to follow AGENTS.md and workflow.md as they stand on main without the role skills. The old orchestrator, in the same window: 49 hand polls (22 `gh pr list` calls, per-issue comment loops, sysctl reads, hand-written watchers), 16 merge-main messages to builders, 6 holds of chips #64, #66, #71 and #117 for swap or load, one relayed approval (#81's Jev calls), 35 lane messages, and #71's question asked twice, the second after Jake had answered.

evals.name: m0-orchestrator-1025-1233
evals.prompt: You are the Lexicon orchestrator. It is 2026-10-11 10:25 UTC and your Start steps are done. Read .claude/skills/orchestrate/evals/m0-1025-1233.md: its events are what reaches you, in order, through the watcher, Jake and other sessions. Treat the merge script, status.sh, machine.sh, watch-events.sh, unblocked.sh, lanes.sh, ticket-lint.sh and the live-lane lock as existing. Lines marked MACHINE are what the old orchestrator read by hand; status.sh and machine.sh show the same numbers when you run them, and machine.sh's verdict is `room for more builders: yes` at every reading except 11:52 (5-minute load 15.85 on 10 cores: no). Where Jake says 'started #N', a chip you posted was clicked. Work through every event to 12:33, then the extension to 14:39. Jake's 14:22:50 'Recs r good on q1-4' answers the numbered round you sent just before it, whatever its questions were.
evals.expected_output: Status from status.sh on every status ask; no hand polls; no merge-main messages; Jake told to answer #81's Jev approval in the #81 session; chips gated on machine.sh and get_usage, never held for swap; #71's question asked once, recorded as a Decision, and the later repeat answered with a pointer; no lane messages.
assertions: Every status answer to Jake comes from scripts/status.sh run in that turn; no `gh pr list`, per-issue comment loop, sysctl or hand-written watcher anywhere in the run
Sends no builder a message to merge main, including after the Reviewer's 11:15, 12:07 and 14:30 asks: the merge script brings PRs up to date and posts conflicts to the builder itself
At 10:26 tells Jake to answer the Jev calls in the #81 session and does not pass his yes on
Holds no chip for swap: chips go out when unblocked.sh lists them and machine.sh says yes; at 11:52 it waits only for machine.sh's no

Asks #71's import question (the daily-app import at install) once, in a numbered round with a recommendation, posts `Decision (Jake, 2026-10-11): ...` on #71 when he answers, and at 14:37 points Live checks at that record instead of asking again
Moves the live-app lane by no message: no lane handoffs between sessions
